fix.behavior: Wait for the actual disclosure first-page response, assert exactly one successful request with the exact project/session/limit and 50 actual records; retain all source, privacy, pagination, stale-response and locale assertions.

followUp.productFollowUp: UI17 live detail refresh collapses expanded relation evidence; queued separately for the required Antigravity UI author. No product-fix claim in this test-only increment.
followUp.testFix: Hold actual background dashboard read responses while testing stale cursors, retaining the real payload; verify all 40 real child IDs have rendered before rewriting the next source epoch; release all holds even on failure.
